lyra.downed: The standard... keep it where I can see it.
lyra.retreat: Take the standard. Get them home. I'll follow.
lyra.death: Take the standard. Get them home. I'll follow.

oren.downed: A hand, please. These old knees won't answer.
oren.retreat: Someone else must hold the gate today.
oren.death: Leave the gate open... they're still coming home.

sera.downed: I can still see the stars. Come back for me.
sera.retreat: I'll mark the way back. You keep moving.
sera.death: North star... guide them when I cannot.

ivo.downed: Pressure on the wound. My bag... bring my bag.
ivo.retreat: Even a medic needs help. Cover my retreat.
ivo.death: My medicines... give them to whoever needs them.

mara.downed: Not overboard yet. Throw me a line.
mara.retreat: Bad current. I'm pulling back to shore.
mara.death: Tell the harbor... my debts are finally settled.

tarin.downed: I miscalculated. Quickly... help me correct it.
tarin.retreat: The work must survive. I'm taking it back.
tarin.death: The last page... promise you'll finish it.

nell.downed: There's a way out. I just need a little help.
nell.retreat: The message gets through. Even if I have to crawl.
nell.death: One last delivery... don't let it go unanswered.

bram.downed: Easy, girl. Stay with me. Someone will come.
bram.retreat: We're going home, girl. Just a little farther.
bram.death: Take care of her... she knows the road home.

esme.downed: I haven't finished the verse. Please... stay.
esme.retreat: My voice is failing. I'll find it again at camp.
esme.death: Sing their names... and mine, if you remember.

rook.downed: I won't run. Just... don't leave me here.
rook.retreat: This time I'm coming back. You have my word.
rook.death: Tell them... I stayed this time.

faye.downed: Follow my tracks. I haven't gone far.
faye.retreat: I'll take the old path. Meet me beyond the trees.
faye.death: The path goes on... even where I cannot.

cassian.downed: No titles now. I need your help.
cassian.retreat: My pride can wait. The company cannot.
cassian.death: No crown was worth... what you gave me.

vela.downed: The light's still burning. Don't lose sight of me.
vela.retreat: I'm going back to tend the light. Find your way to it.
vela.death: Keep a light... for the ones still at sea.

dax.downed: A little help here! We've lifted worse together.
dax.retreat: I'm no use flat on the dock. I'll be back.
dax.death: Stand together... that's how we made them listen.

una.downed: I still have something to say. Help me stand.
una.retreat: There must be another road. I'll find it.
una.death: When the fighting stops... listen to each other.

silas.downed: No secrets. I'm hurt. I need you.
silas.retreat: No disappearing this time. You'll find me at camp.
silas.death: At least... that last promise was true.

petra.downed: Still holding. Bring a brace... or a shoulder.
petra.retreat: Even good stone cracks. I'll mend what I can.
petra.death: Keep the bridge standing... for everyone after us.

ari.downed: Fly back! Tell them where I fell!
ari.retreat: One more flight, little friend. Take us home.
ari.death: Go on... someone is waiting for your message.

noor.downed: Not darkness yet. I can still see you.
noor.retreat: That false sun can wait one more night.
noor.death: Let them see... an ordinary dawn.

galen.downed: The blue packet. Crush the leaves... gently.
galen.retreat: Roots mend slowly. I must give them time.
galen.death: Plant something here... something that will flower.

yuna.downed: A missed step. Help me find my feet.
yuna.retreat: I'll leave by the quiet passage. Keep their eyes on you.
yuna.death: No more counted steps... I wanted to dance freely.

hale.downed: Still air in my lungs. Dig me out of this.
hale.retreat: Bad footing. I'm going back for solid ground.
hale.death: Seal that engine... let the mountain sleep.

elian.downed: Hold formation. Someone... help me up.
elian.retreat: I owe you better than a useless death. I'm withdrawing.
elian.death: These were the right people... to stand beside.

rhea.downed: The letter... don't let it fall. And don't leave me.
rhea.retreat: I haven't answered him yet. I cannot stop here.
rhea.death: Tell him... I chose the people he forgot.
